item.title: SSC CHSL 10+2 Vacancy 2026
item.description: SSC CHSL 2026 notification has been released for 2,536 tentative vacancies for posts including LDC/JSA, DEO and DEO Grade ‘A’. Eligible 12th-pass candidates can apply online from 07/09/2026 to 07/10/2026. The recruitment process will include the prescribed SSC CHSL examination stages, with Tier-I and Tier-II exam dates to be announced. Candidates should check the official notification for detailed post-wise eligibility, age limit, vacancy details and other requirements.
